name: vome-automation
description: A side pane for the Home Assistant automation Claude is working on: triggers, conditions and actions as HA's editor nests them, what a save changed, which steps the latest run took, and a car-stereo dot-matrix display that acts it out. Works with @vortitron/home-assistant-mcp, hosted on Vome, linked through the Vome relay, or pointed at your own Home Assistant.
